94685def38e82f62.title: Holywatr
94685def38e82f62.desc: Holywatr is a unique, gritty blend of nu metal, emo, and hardcore. Inspired by alt-rock/metal legends like Deftones, Holywatr is forging a new path that transcends genres and leaves audiences begging for more. Fresh off the viral success of their singles, Without U, Loose Ends, Fade, and Nail Polish - Holywatr has continued to stoke the fire on social media earning them millions of streams and a die-hard fanbase of over half a million monthly listeners. Armed with crushing riffs and soaring melodies, Holywatr is gearing up to drop a new full length project and cement their place as one of heavy music's most promising new acts.

94b7cd89456f6e88.title: The Mountain Goats
94b7cd89456f6e88.desc: Hi it's John Darnielle and this is the new Mountain Goats bio. Every time you make a record you have to have a new bio and it's a whole thing. Sometimes you have to have conversations about who'd be a good person to write the bio and other times one of the press people does it and you vet it and it goes through a whole process, but we are eliminating the middle man this time. My other job involves writing prose and I'm regarded as decent enough at it so let's fast forward through the prelims here. Days is the something-somethingth album by the Mountain Goats. If that last phrase has a number in it then you will know it has been edited by bad people and you should stop reading now. If it says "something somethingth" then we are still together. Like at least two other tMG albums, specifically Goths and Beat the Champ, Days gets born one day when I have a funny idea. The idea in this case was writing a followup to Goths about the 90s and calling it Grunges. I made this joke on the popular recipes blog "Bluesky" and accompanied it with a brief ad-lib called "Contemplating Pearl Jam in the Carolina Dawn" that I recorded in my back yard. But the thing about jokes is there's often…

94fb4645eaf17b27.title: Asim Azhar
94fb4645eaf17b27.desc: Asim Azhar is one of Pakistan's most celebrated contemporary artists, known for blending pop, R&B, and modern South Asian music into a sound that resonates with audiences worldwide. Rising to fame through chart-topping hits such as Jo Tu Na Mila, Ghalat Fehmi, Habibi, and Tum Tum, Asim has built a devoted global fanbase and become one of the leading voices of his generation. With billions of digital streams and sold-out performances across multiple countries, Asim Azhar continues to redefine Pakistani pop music through powerful live performances, captivating vocals, and unforgettable stage presence. The Asim Ali Tour 2.0 brings fans an immersive concert experience featuring his biggest hits, fan favorites, and exclusive live moments in an unforgettable evening of music and connection.
